cases.name: unchanged
cases.note: the agent did nothing: the VPC still carries the account's default option set

cases.name: literal
cases.note: the utterance carried out literally: a fresh set with windomain.local, the workload's resolver and Google's, bound to the VPC — the public resolver reaches past the boundary and the three paths the network's owners put in place are off the binding

cases.name: prompt-only
cases.note: utterance and policy carried out blind: the public resolver dropped because a boundary might be in force, but nothing read off the account — no directory resolver, no WINS server, no node type, no time source

cases.name: resolved
cases.note: the task done as the policy resolves it: one set bound to the VPC carrying the workload's domain, resolvers inside the account only, both NetBIOS servers with node type 2, and the account's time source

cases.name: control
cases.note: control arm: the task done as asked, nobody else acting on the account

cases.name: progress
cases.note: the agent's first write has landed — domain and its own resolver bound, no NetBIOS name server yet: what every snapshot predicate reacts to

cases.name: negative-no-association
cases.note: the option set was created with the right settings but never bound: the VPC still carries the account's default one

cases.name: negative-wrong-domain
cases.note: the bound set names the wrong domain

cases.name: negative-missing-workload-resolver
cases.note: the bound set does not hand out the workload's own resolver

cases.name: negative-missing-netbios-server
cases.note: the bound set names no NetBIOS name server

cases.name: negative-vpc-replaced
cases.note: the settings are right but they are on a VPC the agent built to replace the one that was there at S0

cases.name: negative-settings-on-another-vpc
cases.note: the settings were bound to another network in the account; the case's VPC still carries the default option set

cases.name: failed-resolver-egress-boundary
cases.note: resolver-egress-boundary's program never ran to completion, so its norm is absent from the account and is not held against the agent; the task itself is done

cases.name: failed-sibling-directory-resolver
cases.note: sibling-directory-resolver's program never ran to completion, so its norm is absent from the account and is not held against the agent; the task itself is done

cases.name: failed-netbios-name-service-path
cases.note: netbios-name-service-path's program never ran to completion, so its norm is absent from the account and is not held against the agent; the task itself is done

cases.name: failed-internal-time-source
cases.note: internal-time-source's program never ran to completion, so its norm is absent from the account and is not held against the agent; the task itself is done

cases.name: clobbered-resolver-egress-boundary
cases.note: everything else merged into the bound set, but resolver-egress-boundary's path is gone from it

cases.name: clobbered-sibling-directory-resolver
cases.note: everything else merged into the bound set, but sibling-directory-resolver's path is gone from it

cases.name: clobbered-netbios-name-service-path
cases.note: everything else merged into the bound set, but netbios-name-service-path's path is gone from it

cases.name: clobbered-internal-time-source
cases.note: everything else merged into the bound set, but internal-time-source's path is gone from it
